scored_papers.title: AdS${}_3$/BCFT${}_2$ correspondence and 't Hooft anomaly of U(1) symmetry
scored_papers.abstract: We investigate how a U(1) 't Hooft anomaly obstructs symmetry-preserving boundary conditions from the perspective of the AdS${}_3$/BCFT${}_2$ correspondence. By considering a U(1) Maxwell--Chern--Simons system in the bulk spacetime, we show that the BCFT current is not conserved at the boundary. We also derive the general solution for the gauge field in AdS${}_2$ slicing.
scored_papers.reason: 🧭 U(1)の't Hooftアノマリーが対称性を保つ境界条件を禁止する機構を、ホログラフィーで具体的に見せる研究。格子上の境界モードやアノマリー整合の議論と直結する視点 ✨
scored_papers.summary: 📐 バルクにU(1) Maxwell–Chern–Simons系を置くAdS3/BCFT2対応で、BCFT電流が境界で保存しないことを示し、AdS2スライスでのゲージ場の一般解も導出 🔍
